items.name: Allianz
clues: Serious, safe and reliable: the company you call when something goes wrong.
Founded in Berlin in 1890. Its headquarters are now in Munich.
A worldwide partner of the Olympic and Paralympic Games since 2021.
Its name is on a Munich stadium that glows red on match nights. In UEFA competitions, the stadium has to use a different name.
Stadiums in Sydney and São Paulo carry its name too.
It's an insurance company, and Bayern Munich play in the ___ Arena.

items.name: Adidas
clues: Sporty, German and a bit retro: your dad's tracksuit and your favourite trainers.
Registered in Herzogenaurach, Bavaria, in 1949. The founder's brother started a rival company in the same town.
In 1986 a hip-hop trio wrote a song about its trainers and got a deal worth $1.6 million: the first big shoe deal for musicians, not athletes.
On the shirts of Bayern Munich, Manchester United and Juventus.
Its three-leaf trefoil logo now marks its classic 'Originals' range.
Named after its founder, Adi Dassler. Think three stripes.

items.name: Rolex
clues: Expensive, classic and calm: what people buy when they finally get the big promotion.
Founded in London in 1905, before it moved to Geneva.
Official timekeeper at Wimbledon since 1978.
Its clocks sit beside the courts at big tennis tournaments, and on the scoreboards at golf's biggest events.
Roger Federer has advertised its watches for years.
A five-letter Swiss watch brand with a crown as its logo.

items.name: Emirates
clues: Glamorous and international: huge planes, cabin crew in red hats and a lot of gold.
Founded in Dubai in 1985.
Since 2006 Arsenal have played in a London stadium named after it.
On the front of Real Madrid's and AC Milan's shirts, and on the side of its planes.
Its slogan, 'Fly Better', is printed on football shirts.
An airline named after the country it comes from: the United Arab ___.

items.name: Spotify
clues: Young, green and always in your ears.
Founded in Stockholm in 2006.
In 2022 it signed a deal with FC Barcelona for the shirts and the name of the stadium.
On Barcelona's shirts, it has sometimes swapped its logo for a musician's: Drake's owl in 2022, the Rolling Stones' tongue in 2023.
Every December, millions of people post their year in music from it on Instagram.
The biggest music streaming service: Barcelona now play at ___ Camp Nou.

items.name: Heineken
clues: Friendly, international and green: it likes to be seen with football fans and racing fans.
Founded in Amsterdam in 1864.
It has sponsored the UEFA Champions League since 2005, after another beer from the same group did it before.
On the boards at Formula 1 races since 2016, often with a message not to drink and drive.
In the 2012 James Bond film Skyfall, 007 drinks it on screen, as part of a big product-placement deal.
A Dutch beer in a green bottle with a red star, named after the family that founded it.
